name: Legends of the Tidesages

aliases: what is legends of the tidesages
faq.answer: It is a magical tome delivered to expand the archives of the Library in Ironforge.
faq.q: What is Legends of the Tidesages?

aliases: who wants legends of the tidesages
where to take legends of the tidesages
faq.answer: Scholars at the Library in Ironforge accept the work to preserve its knowledge and add to their collection.

aliases: what happens after legends of the tidesages
faq.answer: The scholars ask that you bring them any further magical writings you recover that could aid the library.
faq.q: Can more books be brought to the library?

sections.body: Scholars in Ironforge seek to broaden their understanding of arcane and historical lore. Each volume retrieved from the wider world preserves lore that might otherwise vanish into obscurity.
sections.title: Gathering Knowledge

summary: A tome of obscure lore has made its way to the Library in Ironforge. Scholars there welcome such additions, eager to deepen their collection of arcane knowledge.
attribution: In-game quest text: Legends of the Tidesages
